# Retail CoD UO 1.51b dedicated server, 2026-10-15: the PROBE lines of
# client-probes/probe_vehicle_armor on mp_peaks with probe_aim_sweep 1.
# COD_VERSION=uo PORT=31231 PROBE_SECS=115 tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_vehicle_armor
#   mp_peaks +set probe_vehicletype willyjeep_mp +set probe_side 75 +set probe_aim_sweep 1
# then, 18 s in, the target: vcod --game-dir <UO> --mod-dir uo --net-probe 127.0.0.1:31231
#   --probe-team axis --probe-vehicle sit --probe-secs 95
# and 4 s later the shooter: vcod ... --probe-team allies --probe-weapon thompson_mp
#   --probe-uo-weapon aim --probe-secs 91
# The shooter sends every cmd at the view the gsc set, so every round leaves along the gsc's
# aim, which steps through 0..120 above the target's origin by 8 every half second (the aim
# lines). The target sits 12 s as the driver, the MG gunner and the passenger, then gets out.
